UT, Utopia of the Seas, friends relaxing in pool, fun, day, action, water, excitement, Weekend like it's hot ONBOARD EXPERIENCES Escape to the sun and party it up with your choice of shimmering pools and adrenaline-pumping waterslides. Enjoy dining destinations that make every meal momentous and take your pick of action-packed bars and world-class entertainment. So, grab your crew and celebrate the weekend on the cruise line voted Best Overall by Travel Weekly readers for 23 years running. PLAN YOUR BEACH DAY AT 2 PRIVATE DESTINATIONS Every weekend cruise onboard Wonder of the Seas® includes an action-packed stop at one or both of our must-see private destinations. Pump up the adrenaline at the award-winning Perfect Day CocoCay and conquer Daredevil’s Peak®, the tallest waterslide in the Caribbean. And grab a day pass to the all-new Royal Beach Club℠ Paradise Island and experience two pristine beaches and three pools at the biggest beach bash in Nassau. its big time gradient option a 8 WHAT’S INCLUDED WITH YOUR CRUISE FARE (AT LITERALLY NO EXTRA COST) COMPLIMENTARY DINING COMPLIMENTARY EXPERIENCES ESCAPE THE EVERYDAY WITH FRIENDS AND FAMILY You've never weekended like this before — with more onboard to see, do, play and conquer. Lounge on the resort-style pool deck, get your adrenaline pumping on the Ultimate Abyss℠ and dance the night away at one of the rave-worthy parties onboard. PLAY ALL DAY ADVENTURES Swap your ordinary weekend plans for all-out thrills on Wonder of the Seas®. Tee off at Wonder Dunes, where kids can navigate an undersea mini golf course, while couples can challenge each other on the Perfect Storm℠ slides or conquer the Ultimate Abyss℠. Whether racing, relaxing, or exploring, there's excitement for everyone aboard. THE ULTIMATE KICK BACK Escape the hustle and find your perfect weekend retreat. Teens can hang out in their exclusive space, Social100, where gaming, music, and movies await. The patio features lawn games, a juice bar, and a whirlpool to unwind under the sun or stars. Meanwhile, couples can relax in the adults-only Solarium, indulge in rejuvenating massages at Vitality℠ Spa, and enjoy panoramic views at Vue Bar℠. DATE NIGHT DELIGHTS When the sun goes down on Wonder of the Seas®, the party’s just getting started. Kick off the evening with a striking show at the AquaTheater. Then sing along to your favorite tunes at Spotlight Karaoke before heading out to one of the themed parties onboard. From endless onboard thrills to gourmet globetrotting and top-notch shows, Wonder of the Seas® surprises with thrills and wow-worthy experiences at every turn. Like The Perfect Storm℠ waterslide trio and a zip line 10 decks high. Or Splashaway Bay℠ aqua park, where kids have gallons of fun. And with over 20 mouthwatering dining options, it’s easy to treat yourself to a delicious globetrotting adventure. Plus when it comes to showstopping entertainment, Wonder of the Seas® dazzles with shows that transcend air and water. Take a peek at our guides to discover all the adventures that await you onboard.
